subject.title: SQLite state stores fail on long Windows paths

question: Should the long-path classifier be introduced as a shared core/package contract with a supported plugin-facing helper, or should plugin stores retain owner-specific adapters around a common lower-level primitive?
rationale: The core-versus-plugin boundary and permanence of any shared helper are compatibility-sensitive product and SDK decisions; the issue describes the required behavior but does not establish the preferred public contract.

options.title: Approve a shared classified-location helper
options.body: Create one generic helper for SQLite filesystem locations and expose only the narrow plugin-safe surface needed by plugin-owned stores.

options.title: Keep plugin adapters owner-specific
options.body: Use a common internal primitive in core while each plugin package owns its own adapter, avoiding a new SDK surface at the cost of repeated integration work.

recommendation.title: Approve a shared classified-location helper
recommendation.body: Create one generic helper for SQLite filesystem locations and expose only the narrow plugin-safe surface needed by plugin-owned stores.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to this repository member and they authored the scoped related report that established the Windows failure boundary.
